cool-air-new-jersey.notes: Site content appears copied from a New York template; market fit must be confirmed before outreach.
cool-air-new-jersey.valueHypothesis: Every website route to a written inquiry is broken. The hero 'Contact Us', 'Appointment' and 'Get A Quote' buttons have empty links and do nothing when clicked, and the contact and appointment pages contain no form. Visitors who will not phone have no way to reach the business online. The 'Service', 'AC Repair & Installation' and 'Heating & Cooling' pages return 404. If Cool Air serves Hudson County homeowners, NYC-focused copy may also misdirect local visitors. Traffic, lead volume and revenue impact are unknown.
cool-air-new-jersey.recommendedSolution: Connect the hero buttons to a short service-request form that routes to email/SMS with an automatic acknowledgement. Restore or redirect the three 404 service pages. Add a sticky mobile call bar (no call button on the first mobile screen today). Rewrite location copy for the towns actually served. Force HTTPS.
cool-air-new-jersey.outreachAngle: Open with the dead 'Appointment' button and the 404 'Service' page (screenshots, reproducible in seconds). Ask which area they serve before raising the New York copy. Make no revenue claims.
researchNeeds: Confirm whether the business serves NYC, Hudson County or both, and whether it is related to New Jersey PTAC Services (also Jersey City, PTAC-focused, NYC copy)
Identify the owner (the site names nobody); email info@coolairnewjersey.com is published

air-plus-hvac.valueHypothesis: Three phone numbers are in circulation: the Google listing (973) 521-2708, the number printed on the site (973) 521-5028, and the number the 'CALL' buttons actually dial, (973) 652-2424, which appears nowhere else. If 652-2424 is not answered by the business, callers from the website are lost. The only other inquiry path is a mailto: link to a Gmail address. Impact is unverified until the business confirms which line is monitored.
air-plus-hvac.recommendedSolution: Use one tracked business number consistently across the Google listing, site text and every tel: link. Replace the mailto 'Get a Quote' with a request form routed to CRM/SMS. Build real service pages (the SERVICES/HEATING/COOLING/PLUMBING navigation items are '#' anchors).
air-plus-hvac.outreachAngle: Ask one factual question: which number should customers call? Show the button markup dialing 652-2424. Do not place test calls without the business's agreement.
researchNeeds: Identify the owner (single-page site names nobody)
Find tenure and capacity evidence (none on site; no BBB match)

all-week-mechanical-group-air-conditioni.valueHypothesis: The top-navigation 'Services', 'Residential' and 'Commercial' links, plus the local heating, boiler, furnace and oil-to-gas pages, all return 404. Visitors researching a specific service hit dead ends, while the request forms themselves load. Eight Google listings across Hudson, Bergen, Passaic and Essex link to this website, each with a different local phone number, so the dead pages are reached from many entry points. Traffic and lead impact are unknown.
all-week-mechanical-group-air-conditioni.recommendedSolution: Restore or 301-redirect the 10 dead URLs. Add automated weekly link monitoring with alerts. Force HTTPS. Then confirm where the existing web-form leads go and add instant acknowledgement and CRM routing (current handling unknown).
all-week-mechanical-group-air-conditioni.outreachAngle: Send the dead-URL list with screenshots. First identify a decision-maker: the site names nobody and publishes no email. Use the main office line.
researchNeeds: Identify owner/decision-maker
Confirm the number of real locations behind the 8 Google listings and how calls to the 8 local numbers are routed
